headline: Williams and Alpine are caught breaking F1's cost cap days before Qatar, the AI chip sell-off briefly knocks 4% off the Nasdaq, and SpaceX gets the nod for data centres in orbit.

upcoming.what: F1 Qatar GP, 16:00 Irish time (qualifying Sat 18:00)
Cygnus CRS-25 launch to the ISS on Falcon 9, ~15:47 Irish time
Rayman Legends Retold (PC, PS5, Xbox, Switch 2)
UFC Riyadh: Adesanya vs Magomedov, plus Ian Machado Garry vs Amosov (prelims 15:00, main card 18:00 Irish)
F1 Abu Dhabi GP season finale, 13:00 Irish time

items.headline: AI chip sell-off briefly drags Nasdaq down 4%
items.summary: Nvidia, AMD and Micron led a sharp midday rout on renewed doubts about the AI trade and sticky inflation, before markets clawed back most of the losses by the close.

items.headline: SpaceX cleared to put data centres in orbit
items.summary: US regulators approved SpaceX's plan for a huge constellation of space-based data centres, a historic filing covering up to a million satellites, as the AI compute race heads skyward.

items.headline: Roundup: everything else in AI yesterday
items.summary: A quieter day for launches after the Anthropic IPO wobble; this digest rounds up the smaller model and product news from 25 November.

items.headline: FCC approval opens door to million-satellite SpaceX network
items.summary: The same approval is a big deal for astronomers too: a constellation on that scale would dwarf Starlink and raise fresh concerns about satellite streaks and orbital crowding.

items.headline: Space Force launch caps a busy day in orbit
items.summary: A US Space Force mission rounded off a packed 25 November for launches; the briefing has the full rundown.

items.headline: Cygnus CRS-25 still set for Sunday
items.summary: Northrop Grumman's ISS cargo run on Falcon 9 remains targeted for around 15:47 Irish time on 29 November.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: poor for deep-sky, moon still dominant
items.summary: Sunset is around 16:20 with full darkness by about 18:15, but a bright waning gibbous moon (roughly 90% lit) rises in the early evening and washes out faint targets. The cloud forecast couldn't be retrieved this morning, so check Met Éireann; if skies clear, the best window is roughly 18:15-19:30 before the moon climbs, with Jupiter rising in the east later.

items.headline: Cyberpunk 2 development ramps up at CDPR
items.summary: CD Projekt says more staff are moving onto the Cyberpunk sequel, and insists GTA 6's success hasn't changed its ambitions for the project.

items.headline: Witcher 3 engagement at 'historic' highs after remaster
items.summary: CDPR's Q3 numbers show the Witcher 3 remaster driving record player engagement, even as overall revenue fell sharply with Cyberpunk 2077 sales cooling.

items.headline: Still quiet; No-Gi Worlds 10-12 December
items.summary: No major results or announcements in the last couple of days. The IBJJF No-Gi World Championship is the next big date.

items.headline: Josh Thomson calls Machado Garry 'boring' ahead of Riyadh
items.summary: The former fighter turned pundit took aim at the Irishman's style before his 5 December bout with Yaroslav Amosov on the Adesanya vs Magomedov card.

items.headline: No UFC this weekend
items.summary: The UFC is off over 28-29 November; Riyadh on 5 December is next, main card around 18:00 Irish.

items.headline: Williams and Alpine found in breach of the F1 cost cap
items.summary: The FIA ruled both teams overspent under the budget cap and issued sanctions, landing just days before the Qatar GP.

items.headline: Alpine explains its overspend
items.summary: The team set out what caused its breach as the FIA confirmed its penalty; Williams also issued a statement on its own sanction.

items.headline: Lawson sets a 'very strong' target after keeping his seat
items.summary: With his Racing Bulls future secured, Liam Lawson has laid out big goals for next season. Qatar race is Sunday at 16:00 Irish.
